meta.note: Bundled forward calendar. Confirmed dates are the Fed's published 2026 meetings and the purely calendrical third-Friday expiries. Everything marked estimated was inferred from a publisher's long-standing pattern and is replaced by the published date on the first successful refresh.

rules.ppi: the business day after CPI, 8:30am ET
rules.jobs: first Friday of the month (second when the first falls on the 1st), 8:30am ET
rules.fomc: 2:00pm ET on the second day of the two-day meeting
rules.opex: third Friday, 4:00pm ET; triple witching and index rebalance in Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec
rules.treasury_auction: Treasury's fixed weekly bill and monthly coupon cycle, bidding closing 1:00pm ET
rules.earnings: the week each company has reported in historically

items.title: Triple witching
items.text: Stock options, index options and index futures all expire together on the third Friday. The largest expiry of the quarter: prices tend to be pinned to big strikes into it and to move more freely once it clears.

items.title: Quarterly index rebalance
items.text: S&P index changes take effect at this close, so index funds must trade the adds and deletes whatever the price. Which names are affected is announced about a week ahead and is not in this app yet, which is why this event carries no ticker.
